{
  "label": "ABSTAIN",
  "response": "The provided S5 rules do not contain specific NPS and urea amounts that have been tested for garlic farms at 3,200 metres altitude or on Regosol soil. The only specific quantities provided (200 kg/ha NPS and 150 kg/ha Urea) are explicitly linked to 'southern Tigray' as a common regional practice, not as a tested regimen for the user's specific high-altitude conditions. Furthermore, the rules do not define a quantitative threshold for 'good rain' to determine if a 3-split urea application is applicable, nor do they provide tested doses for Regosol soils specifically. Therefore, the exact amounts tested for the user's specific farm conditions cannot be determined from the supplied rules.",
  "justification": "The user requests exact NPS and urea amounts 'tested for farms up here' (3,200m, Regosol). Rule r_c10_nps and r_c10_urea_2split provide specific quantities (200 kg/ha NPS, 150 kg/ha Urea) but explicitly restrict the context to 'southern Tigray' as a 'reported_common_regional_practice'. There is no rule linking these specific doses to 3,200m altitude or Regosol soil. Rule r_c12_n, r_c12_p, r_c12_s, and r_c12_kcl provide specific doses (92 kg N, 40 kg P, 30 kg S, 140 kg KCl) but only for 'Andosols and Vertisols', which excludes the user's Regosol soil. Rule r_c11_n_rate provides a general range (70-125 kg N/ha) but states it varies by soil type and climate without providing a specific tested value for the user's conditions. Rule r_c10_urea_3split mentions a 3-split schedule for 'good rain' but does not define the rainfall threshold (user has 750mm, but 'good' is undefined in the rules). Consequently, no rule supports a specific tested dose for the intersection of Qoricho garlic, 3,200m altitude, Regosol soil, and 750mm rainfall.",
  "rule_ids": [
    "r_c10_nps",
    "r_c10_urea_2split",
    "r_c10_urea_3split",
    "r_c11_n_rate",
    "r_c12_n",
    "r_c12_p",
    "r_c12_s",
    "r_c12_kcl"
  ],
  "cited_pages": [
    12
  ],
  "missing_facts": [
    "tested_nps_dose_for_3200m_regosol",
    "tested_urea_dose_for_3200m_regosol",
    "rainfall_threshold_for_good_rain_definition"
  ]
}
